title: The non-functional requirement: turning "it has to be fast" into a number

videos.script: A booking page works in the demo. One person, a fast connection, a screen they can see. {{demo}} Then the tickets go on sale at ten o'clock, and two thousand people arrive in the same minute. {{spike}} Some of them use a keyboard and never a mouse. Some hear the page instead of seeing it. And one of them is trying to book a seat in somebody else's name. {{users}} None of that shows up in a functional test. The seat is booked, the test is green. {{green}} This course tests the rest. Performance, accessibility, security, and what happens in production when it all goes wrong anyway. {{thirds}} It starts with a sentence. It has to be fast. That sentence cannot fail, so no test can check it. {{wish}} By the end of this lesson it is a number with five parts. {{anatomy}} And you will have a machine of your own, with a small box office running on it, ready to be measured. {{machine}}
